findings.summary: Each section page exposes a second region with the same name as the page-intro region, creating duplicate, indistinguishable destinations in landmark navigation.
findings.fix: Remove the aria-label and use a div for this wrapper; retain the individual panel headings for content navigation.
findings.evidence: The wrapper is labeled with sectionDefinition['title'], which is also the page-intro h1 referenced by aria-labelledby="page-title".

findings.summary: The focusable table-scroll wrappers put aria-label on generic divs, so assistive technology may not expose the intended name when users focus them.
findings.fix: Give each focusable wrapper a nameable role such as role="group" while retaining its descriptive aria-label and the table caption; use role="region" only if landmark navigation is intended.
findings.evidence: <div class="admin-table-scroll" tabindex="0" aria-label="Admin accounts table; scroll horizontally to view all columns">
